mission.title: Bombs and Betrayal
mission.description: Find out what the Agents' planned attack on the city is, and stop it.

npc.say: You have no choice in the matter.
He may be a patient man, but someone like yourself shouldn't keep him waiting.

phase.briefing:
We've uncovered an important piece of information from the PDA devices that you've been recovering from Agents. The data that we've decoded informs us that an attack has been planned by Agents to make a strike against an entire section of the city. Under normal circumstances the Merovingian would pay little mind to the Machines and their petty war, and especially the truce, with Zion. In this case, we must make an exception. According to very reliable sources, the scale of this attack is sizable enough to have an effect on a large number of Exiles and Operatives working in the area, including yourself. And well... we just can't have that, can we?
The decoded data leads us to this address. We believe it to be some sort of base of operations for the Agents. Go there and seek out any additional leads that will prevent us from having to go through the chore of re-staffing.
Do we understand? Good.

enter.say: The Agents are inside. Search the place and try to find any information that will give us further leads into the suspected attack on the city.

objective.text: Unlock the door to Agent Miller's office

done.say: That unlocked the door to Agent Miller's office. We may find our lead in here, but be careful!
Now we're getting somewhere. Find out what that key goes to.
With Agent Miller dead, you can search his office for any information on the suspected attack.

objective.text: Get the access codes from Agent Miller

done.say: Those are the access codes to Agent Miller's computer. You should have access to his personal files now.

This is very interesting... Sirius is one of the Merovingian's men and we haven't heard from him in quite some time. It is disturbing that we find an email from him here. You must pay Sirius a visit. I will send you the address of his residence once you are out of this location.

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of Sirius's last known location. He's not answering his cell phone, so you're just going to have to pay him a visit.

enter.say: This is where Sirius has been staying. Search the place and see if he's still here.

done.say: You found Sirius, but... he's dead! Why am I not surprised... Search his body.
His cell phone! Let me check the last few numbers dialed on his phone...
Give me a minute and I'll go over these numbers. I should have some data for you by the time you step outside.

complete.say: Agents! Don't let them take Sirius's cell phone!

phase.briefing: One of the phone numbers has pulled up something interesting... Sirius received a call from a group of Zion Operatives that are stationed not far from your current location. I don't know what the intent of the Zion Operatives are, but we need to find out what connection they have with Sirius.

enter.say: This is where the Zion Operatives have been traced. Their connection between Sirius and the Machines hasn't been placed yet, but it's my hope that you will uncover the next piece in this puzzle.

done.say: That's the phone that led us here. It even has Sirius's number as the last call placed.
The Zion Operatives are dead! Search their bodies now. We need to recover whatever it is that they received from Sirius.
A tracking device! The device itself appears to be configured to...the bomb! We can use the tracking device to trace the location of the bomb! This is good news, {player}!

near.say: It's Cocodrillo! He's the one that placed the call to Sirius. Kill them!
They've found us! Merovingian operatives and... Agents! Stop them!

complete.say: ...going anywhere, human. We have heard about the situation with the explosive device and have taken it upon ourselves to see to it that the bomb is found. Do not meddle in this affair, {player}.
I don't think we have much of a choice in the matter, {player}. As much as it pains me to tell you this, we have to abide by their request.
You have no choice in the matter.

phase.briefing: The tracking device is pointing us to this address. Go quickly, before the bomb is detonated!

enter.say: This is it, {player}. Recover the bomb!

objective.text: Kill the imposter Agent carrying the bomb

done.say: I do believe that one of the imposter Agents has the bomb on him. Check their bodies!

objective.text: Get the bomb from the imposter Agent

done.say: That's the bomb! Luckily the bomb hasn't been armed yet, however, we still have one problem: disposal. With Sirius dead it will be very difficult for us be rid of the explosives... Wait... I'm getting a transmission from a Redpill Operative... Give me a minute, {player}. Flood will contact you again once you've made it out alive.

phase.briefing: The Operative wouldn't give me his name, but he did tell me that he can dispose of the bomb for us. I want you to look into this. If the Redpill Operative checks out to be legit, we will present the explosive device to him. You've already been updated with the address, so get moving. Delay too much and it could result in your death.

enter.say: Whoever's inside is using a powerful program preventing me from pin-pointing their location with my scanners. I'm sorry, but I can't give you any informtion other than what we already have. Be prepared for anything, {player}!

talk.say:
I hoped we would not meet under such circumstances...
It is I who contacted Flood when I heard that you managed to obtain the explosive device. If you wish the lives of your fellow operatives to not be lost, it would serve us all if we take the bomb off of your hands. You must give it to me.
Did you bring the imposters' bomb? I promise you, I will not use it as a weapon. I have other uses for its component code.

done.say:
You have my thanks.
I didn't doubt that you would make the correct choice in this matter, as it was clear that you've become quite skilled with the way you handled the imposters. Very impressive... This is why it pains me to see you work for the Frenchman. This is a decision that you've made on your own and I cannot change that... Your actions are your own and so is your pursuit for power. Do not forget the freedom that others have brought you which let you obtain strength in the Matrix. Until our paths cross again... May Neo watch over you.

near.say: Those redpills look like they are from Zion. I can only assume that the individual who contacted Flood is from Zion as well.

mission.finish:
I'm still not sure how Morpheus plays a part in this, but one thing is clear; the Agents sabotaging the hardlines are imposters and they don't work for the Machines. I know that holding onto the bomb would have been too much for you, however the Merovingian will be upset that we had to turn to Morpheus for disposal.
You've impressed me, {player}... Just this once.
